text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph on pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio light, entire items visible, realistic materials. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, hanger, stand, typography, logos or watermark. One delicate fine gold chain necklace with a tiny oval loop pendant hanging from a small bail, arranged as a complete narrow oval chain with pendant at lower center.
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Reference image defines CLOTHING AND ACCESSORY DESIGN ONLY. Create one photorealistic wardrobe library product image on a pure white seamless background, vertical 2:3. NO person, no face, no hair, no skin, no body parts, no visible mannequin, no hanger, no display stand, no typography or watermark. Soft neutral studio illumination, realistic fabric/metal textures, subtle contact shadows, full item uncropped with breathing room. Faithfully retain the reference garment design rather than redesigning it. Extract ONLY the fine gold chain necklace from source. One delicate narrow gold chain arranged as a complete closed elongated oval on white, pendant at the lower center: a tiny simple oval loop charm on a small bail, understated everyday jewelry, fine chain links clearly resolved. Reference pendant is very small: preserve a conservative small open oval/teardrop motif, no large gemstones, no brand emblem, no layered necklaces. Realistic close-up product photography; entire chain and pendant visible, no neck, torso, clothes, earrings or bust.
reproduction_note: 依据用户提供造型图整理为纯白背景无人服装、独立配饰与完整造型。小尺寸耳饰和吊坠细节、头发遮挡部分保守补全；不作精确款号或品牌鉴定。需保持设计时结合原参考，不承诺纯文字逐像素复现。
